## Overview
[Record] Rurikid princes of Moscow, rising as the Horde's tribute-collectors. Dmitry Donskoy (1359-89) won Kulikovo (1380), but Tokhtamysh burned Moscow in Aug 1382. Vasily I (1389-1425) married [Sofija](../characters/sofija.qmd), Vytautas's daughter, in 1391; he stood off Vytautas on the Ugra in 1408 and made [Vytautas](../characters/vytautas.qmd) guardian of his son in his 1423 testament. Vasily II (1425-62) was blinded in the civil war of 1446 and restored.

## Patron Force
None canonical. [Saga suggestion] The [Steppe-Hunger](../forces/steppe_hunger.qmd)'s shadow, since Moscow learned rule as the Horde's tributary.

## Internal tensions
Dynastic rivalry between Vasily II and his uncle Yuri's sons; Metropolitan Photius against the Kyiv metropolitan Gregory Tsamblak; Novgorod and Pskov playing Moscow off against Vilnius. The Kęstutaičiai blood survives only here: Sofija's grandson, the blinded Vasily II (V ch. 29 coda).

## Notable members
[Vasily I](../characters/vasily1.qmd), [Sofija](../characters/sofija.qmd).
